review: Use the author ID read from the stored comment, not the ID I can choose in my request body. Otherwise I can impersonate the owner and alter their text.
The saved feed includes another member’s saved post. The query selects bookmark IDs for all accounts; bind the current user ID there.
limit=2.5 reaches Array.slice because the comparisons only bound its range. That violates the integer contract and silently truncates the page size.
src/text.ts already exports excerpt. This function repeats its algorithm, so a future fix could update one summary but leave the other inconsistent.
Replacing bold markers does not remove existing tags. innerHTML will execute an onerror payload saved by another member. Build text nodes instead.
A member typing a dot expects a literal dot. This RegExp treats it as a wildcard and an opening bracket crashes instead of searching literal text.
There is a step registry and a pipeline for one fixed upvote operation. These abstractions make the next maintainer follow several layers just to change that operation.
Only show comments on posts owned by the current member. This SELECT omits posts.authorId=currentUser, exposing other people’s thread activity in my notification list.
Use a larger font for the edit button.
This endpoint needs a security review before release.
Please cover more strange inputs in tests.
